resourceQuotas.title: Resource quotas
resourceQuotas.eventExecutionConstraint: Execution slots cannot exceed the pending event limit.
resourceQuotas.eventByteConstraint: A single event cannot exceed the aggregate encoded byte limit.
resourceQuotas.extensionByteConstraint: The aggregate reservation must fit one request and one result.
resourceQuotas.queueDrainActive: New submissions wait while the queue changes. Already admitted work continues.
resourceQuotas.queueRequiresDrain: Admitted work must drain before the new capacity is confirmed. New submissions are deferred during the drain.
resourceQuotas.queueApplyNote: On confirmation, the running owner checks that the queue and handlers have drained before switching capacity.
resourceQuotas.quotaWriterPending: A quota change is pending. Finish the existing change before adjusting another quota.
resourceQuotas.quotaHistoryFull: The quota change history is full. New changes cannot be saved.
resourceQuotas.quotaPolicyNeedsRestart: The target is saved to startup configuration. The current instance keeps using its existing limits until the next gateway startup confirms the change.
resourceQuotas.awaitingVerifiedBoot: Saved. The next gateway instance must confirm the running limits.
resourceQuotas.southwardSampleAtMostChannel: The channel limit must fit one maximum-sized sample.
resourceQuotas.southwardChannelAtMostGateway: The channel limit cannot exceed the gateway retained-state limit.
resourceQuotas.authCryptoAtMostPending: Password worker concurrency cannot exceed the authentication task limit.
resourceQuotas.loginAccountRetirement: An account with a full bucket is removed at the next login check with a global token available.
resourceQuotas.sessionCountUnavailable: The active session count is temporarily unavailable.
resourceQuotas.sessionLeaseScope: Includes lease records awaiting the next cleanup.
resourceQuotas.sessionUserAtMostTotal: The per-user session limit cannot exceed the gateway session limit.
resourceQuotas.sessionRestartDetail: The new limit applies to issuances after restart. Existing sessions keep their expiration times. Signing out or expiry frees capacity when the limit is reached.
resourceQuotas.authorizationEntryScope: Includes enabled users, roles, memberships, and grants.
resourceQuotas.authorizationByteScope: Measured using the authorization graph loader's input accounting.
resourceQuotas.authorizationCapacityFull: Capacity for new authorization entries or bytes reached
resourceQuotas.authorizationGraphMustFit: The new limit must accommodate the current committed authorization graph.
resourceQuotas.authorizationRestartDetail: After saving, authorization changes must fit both the current and saved startup limits. The startup limits take effect when the replacement gateway confirms them.
resourceQuotas.authorizationPendingConstraint: Until restart, authorization changes must fit both current and saved startup limits.
resourceQuotas.websocketTicketScope: Includes registered tickets awaiting cleanup. A session may expire earlier than its ticket.
resourceQuotas.websocketConnectionScope: Includes admitted connections and connections still closing.
resourceQuotas.websocketSessionTicketsAtMostTotal: The per-session ticket limit cannot exceed the global ticket limit.
resourceQuotas.websocketSessionConnectionsAtMostTotal: The per-session connection limit cannot exceed the global connection limit.
resourceQuotas.websocketRestartDetail: Clients must obtain fresh tickets and reconnect after the replacement gateway starts.
resourceQuotas.websocketAckScope: Each connection can have one unacknowledged batch.
resourceQuotas.websocketAllAwaitingAck: All connection slots have a batch awaiting ACK
resourceQuotas.websocketFrameAtMostBatch: The batch byte limit cannot be lower than the frame byte limit.
resourceQuotas.websocketTrafficPeaks: Observed traffic peaks for this process
resourceQuotas.webUiRetainedFull: The console retained budget is full
resourceQuotas.webUiAssetAtMostContent: An individual asset limit cannot exceed the total source content limit.
resourceQuotas.webUiDepthAtMostPath: The path depth limit cannot exceed the path byte limit.
resourceQuotas.webUiTreeMustFit: The startup limit must accommodate the currently verified asset tree.
resourceQuotas.webUiPreparationRestartDetail: The replacement gateway revalidates and prepares its UI assets before acknowledging the change.
resourceQuotas.webUiResponseRestartDetail: The replacement gateway confirms the new limits before applying them to static asset requests. The preparation timeout runs until the response is ready.
resourceQuotas.webUiResponseAssetPath: Longest verified asset path including the leading slash (decoded length)
resourceQuotas.webUiResponsePathMustFit: A lower path limit must still fit the longest verified asset path.
resourceQuotas.webTlsMaterialScope: Measured from the complete inputs successfully loaded by this owner.
resourceQuotas.webTlsWorkerScope: Includes standing owner overhead and admitted material work.
resourceQuotas.webTlsRetainedScope: Current and older identities and signers held by connections share this budget.
resourceQuotas.webTlsRetainedLimit: Total retained identity and signing limit
resourceQuotas.webTlsSignerAtCapacity: The next handshake signer requires {bytes} bytes
resourceQuotas.webTlsDerBlockAtMostTotal: The DER block limit must fit within the total DER limit per input.
resourceQuotas.webTlsDerTotalAtMostEncoded: The total DER limit must fit within the complete encoded PEM input limit.
resourceQuotas.webTlsWorkerMustFitPem: Reserve at least 4 MiB plus 16 times the encoded PEM limit for each material worker.
resourceQuotas.webTlsMaterialMustFit: New limits must fit the currently loaded TLS material.
resourceQuotas.webTlsRetainedMustFitTwo: The retained budget must hold two identity reservations and its control overhead.
resourceQuotas.webTlsRestartDetail: The replacement gateway reloads and validates its configured TLS material before acknowledging the change.
resourceQuotas.webTemplateAllSlotsUsed: All template job slots are occupied
resourceQuotas.webTemplateJobScope: Uploads, parsing, and exports share job slots until their work retires.
resourceQuotas.webTemplateExportMustFit: The output byte limit must fit within the storage reservation for one job.
resourceQuotas.webTemplateReservationFloor: The job reservation must meet the current workbook decoding and mapping capacity floor.
resourceQuotas.webTemplateReservationCeiling: The job reservation and maximum upload must fit within the process storage budget.
resourceQuotas.webTemplateRestartDetail: The replacement gateway verifies the workbook policy and process storage budget before acknowledging the change.
resourceQuotas.webWorkbookRestartDetail: The replacement gateway validates the archive and workbook policy with the job reservation before acknowledging the change. When the file contains no decoder limits, saving also records the other active values without environment overrides.
resourceQuotas.capabilityBackingFull: The capability reservation budget is full
resourceQuotas.capabilitySlotsScope: Admitted requests and responses awaiting delivery share these slots.
resourceQuotas.capabilityBackingScope: Includes original request and response reservations and standing owner overhead.
resourceQuotas.capabilityRestartDetail: The replacement gateway creates the capability slots and reservation budget before acknowledging the change.
resourceQuotas.webWorkbookEntryMustFit: The expanded size of one entry must fit within the total expanded archive limit.
resourceQuotas.webWorkbookCellMustFit: One cell must fit within the worksheet's total decoded cell data limit.
resourceQuotas.workbookHiddenInvalid: A field in another group needs correction.
resourceQuotas.websocketPeakMessages: Messages in one second on one connection
resourceQuotas.httpRequestSlotsFull: All request slots in use at sample time
resourceQuotas.httpNativeSlotsBusy: All native work slots in use
resourceQuotas.httpRequestSample: Ordinary API requests share these slots.

resourceQuotas.quotaManagementScope: This quota query uses one management slot. Configuration file work is reserved within this budget.
resourceQuotas.quotaManagementFull: All management request slots are occupied
resourceQuotas.httpRefusalsScope: Totals are for the current process. JSON refusals use the limit that applies to each endpoint.
resourceQuotas.engineeringAssetFileMustFit: Total durable bytes must accommodate one maximum-sized input file.
resourceQuotas.engineeringAssetRefusalScope: Uploads and new assets rejected by this instance's file size, catalog count, or total original bytes limit.
resourceQuotas.engineeringAssetRestartDetail: After restart, new assets use the target limits. Existing originals remain readable. The store refuses additions while retained usage exceeds a target.
resourceQuotas.engineeringBrowseRefusalScope: Page item limits and output reservations refused by this instance.
resourceQuotas.engineeringBrowseRestartDetail: After a gateway restart, new browse, preview and comparison requests use the new limits. Existing output retains its original reservation until released.
resourceQuotas.engineeringComparisonRefusalScope: Comparisons refused by this instance's descriptor, scratch byte or semantic work limits.
resourceQuotas.engineeringComparisonRestartDetail: New SCL and MMS comparisons use the new limits after restart. Output page limits appear under Engineering browse and paging.
resourceQuotas.engineeringMappingRefusalScope: Mapping counts and the two reservation pools refused by this instance.
resourceQuotas.engineeringMappingRestartDetail: After restart, new mappings and publication preparation use the new limits. Each mapping output and snapshot retains its reservation until its original work finishes.
resourceQuotas.engineeringPublicationRefusalScope: Publications refused by this instance's revision count or logical storage limit.
resourceQuotas.engineeringPublicationRestartDetail: New publications use the new limits after restart. Existing revisions and audit references are retained. When stored use exceeds the new limits, free capacity or adjust the limits to resume publishing.
resourceQuotas.engineeringSourceRestartDetail: The gateway installs these bounds on restart. A subsequent engineering job will use the installed work and scratch limits.
